sender.ms: Iklan video di Facebook, TikTok atau YouTube yang menampilkan ahli politik, tokoh korporat atau pegawai Bank Negara
sender.en: A video ad on Facebook, TikTok or YouTube showing a politician, a business figure or a Bank Negara official

name.ms: Iklan video deepfake: tokoh terkenal “mengajak” anda melabur
name.en: Deepfake video ad: a well-known figure “invites” you to invest

how.ms: Video yang dihasilkan dengan AI menunjukkan Perdana Menteri, pengurusan kanan syarikat besar, ahli politik atau pegawai Bank Negara dan Suruhanjaya Sekuriti “mengesyorkan” skim pelaburan yang kononnya disokong kerajaan, dengan pulangan sehingga 100 kali ganda. Iklan itu ada butang “Ketahui Lebih Lanjut” yang membawa ke halaman pendaftaran untuk mengisi maklumat peribadi, dan kadangkala meminta anda memuat turun aplikasi. Bank Negara dan SC telah memberi amaran tentang video deepfake yang menyamar sebagai pegawai kanan mereka untuk mempromosikan skim pelaburan persendirian.
how.en: AI-made videos show the Prime Minister, senior management of big companies, politicians or Bank Negara and Securities Commission officials “recommending” an investment scheme supposedly backed by the government, with returns of up to 100 times. The ad has a “Learn More” button leading to a sign-up page for your personal details, and sometimes asks you to download an app. Bank Negara and the SC have warned about deepfake videos impersonating their senior officers to promote private investment schemes.

text.ms: Iklan video menunjukkan tokoh terkenal mempromosikan pelaburan “disokong kerajaan”.

text.ms: Anda diminta mengisi maklumat peribadi dan memuat turun aplikasi untuk mula melabur.
text.en: You are asked to fill in your personal details and download an app to start investing.

text.en: EXCLUSIVE: The government-backed people's investment programme is now open! With just RM1,000, earn up to RM30,000 a month. Limited places, register now ➡️ Learn More [pautan]

ms: Jangan tekan pautan iklan itu. Laporkan iklan kepada platform media sosial.
Semak syarikat di Investment Checker SC, Senarai Amaran Pengguna Kewangan Bank Negara, atau BNMTELELINK.
Jika sudah memindahkan wang, hubungi 997 dan bank anda segera.
en: Don't tap the ad link. Report the ad to the social media platform.
Check the company on the SC's Investment Checker, Bank Negara's Financial Consumer Alert List or with BNMTELELINK.
If you have already sent money, call 997 and your bank straight away.
